description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useApi' that provides high-level functions for interacting with backend APIs related to file upload, job status polling, entity and taxonomy loading, mapping saving, and report downloading. It manages various states such as job ID, status, entities, taxonomy, loading, and error states, utilizing React's hooks like useState, useRef, useEffect, and useCallback.

methods.name: useApi()
methods.description: Provides an interface to upload files, poll job status, load entities and taxonomy, save mappings, and download reports. Manages internal state for these operations.
